title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Salts Strawberry Gummy 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Gummy from the Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection by Doozy Vape Co combines lush fruit notes with a playful sweet shop twist. The profile leads with the bright, natural sweetness of ripe strawberries, featuring a tangy edge that keeps the taste vibrant. A squishy gummy confectionery finish rounds out the exhale, offering a satisfying and textured dessert vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Seriously Pod Fill Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection translates the vibrant flavours of disposable-style profiles into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers everything from juicy fruits to sweet dessert treats. Beyond Strawberry Gummy, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the sweet Strawberry Candy or the refreshing Watermelon Lemonade.
